scope: Targeted matched regression integrity and coverage audit; not held-out. Answer correctness requires separate blinded review.
limitations: Process restart and controlled logical expiry only; no power-loss or spoken-performance claims.

history_exposure.interpretation: Literal old-value matching is a case-insensitive substring lower bound on exposure, not evidence of semantic absence, memory authorization, or answer correctness. Equivalent times, names, paraphrases and alternate formatting may not match. Forwarding witnesses intersect actual generation messages with history_before by exact role/content; system messages, the final current-request message and personal-memory evidence envelopes are excluded. Matching duplicate history indices identify equivalent candidate occurrences, not the unique originating turn.
